name: Granola
rationale: Turn meeting decisions into tasks with source context.
blocker: Workspace, plan and admin limits apply.
next_step: Validate consent, note search, transcript access and links to source meetings.

name: ClickUp
rationale: Extend task assignment, project work and completion to another core task system.
blocker: Beta call quotas; delete tools absent. Native task picker requires an adapter.
next_step: Validate custom-client registration, task create/update/assign/move/complete and task picker mapping.

name: Trello
rationale: Boards, lists and cards match the task organization users requested.
blocker: One workspace per authorization; comments, attachments and membership operations not all present.
next_step: Validate moving cards across lists, ownership and task links. Implement task picker adapter.

name: Sentry
client_access: Any compatible HTTP MCP client documented
rationale: Turn production issues into actionable investigation and fix tasks.
blocker: Account permissions and project scope still apply.
next_step: Validate organization/project scope, issue search, error context and outbound issue links.

name: Context7
rationale: Ground agent execution in current library documentation.
blocker: OAuth endpoint differs from the endpoint in Claude directory.
next_step: Use documented OAuth URL; validate library resolution and documentation retrieval.

name: Zapier
rationale: One integration opens user-selected actions across many services.
blocker: Extra Zapier setup and usage charges; tool set varies by user.
next_step: Test Other-client flow, curated actions, refresh, tool discovery changes and approvals.

name: GitHub
auth: Registered OAuth app or bearer PAT
rationale: Connect tasks to issues, pull requests and repository execution. Not in this Claude directory snapshot.
blocker: Needs registered-client OAuth or named bearer onboarding. Verify overlap with existing repository integration.
next_step: Register our client or offer encrypted scoped PAT, validate issue/PR operations and tool permissions.

name: Tavily
rationale: Provide portable web research and page extraction across harnesses.
blocker: Usage tied to user account; choose one web provider initially.
next_step: Compare with Exa and Firecrawl on representative research tasks; validate OAuth and citations.

name: Exa
auth: Keyless starter path; account options need verification
rationale: Alternative web search and content research provider.
blocker: Named connector currently requires OAuth; starter rate limits differ from an account-backed integration.
next_step: Add explicit no-auth catalog mode if chosen; test limits, retrieval and attribution.

name: Firecrawl
auth: OAuth, bearer API key or limited keyless
rationale: Alternative focused on web scraping and extraction for research tasks.
blocker: Directory publishes search-specific endpoint; full OAuth path is different. Usage limits apply.
next_step: Evaluate full OAuth endpoint and scrape/search parity before selecting research provider.

name: Fireflies
rationale: Alternative meeting transcript and action-item source.
blocker: Plan, transcript permissions and overlap with Granola need evaluation.
next_step: Validate custom consent, meeting search, transcript access and source links.

name: Intercom
rationale: Convert customer conversations and support work into tasks.
blocker: US and EU endpoints differ; Australian workspaces unsupported in current docs.
next_step: Support region choice, validate OAuth eligibility, conversations, contacts and ticket operations.

name: Make
rationale: Run user-authored workflows and connect otherwise unsupported services.
blocker: Scenario setup and scope choice required. Management tools can be broad.
next_step: Prefer scenario-run scopes; verify organization selection and selected workflow behavior.

name: n8n
auth: Instance OAuth or bearer API key
rationale: Support local-first and self-hosted automation without hand-building every service.
blocker: Tenant-specific URL, instance admin enablement and allowed callback configuration required.
next_step: Add validated tenant URL setup; test /mcp-server/http and explicit workflow permissions.

name: Supabase
auth: OAuth with public DCR; PAT alternative
rationale: Give execution agents project schema and database context.
blocker: Project scoping and write-capable database tools require explicit permissions.
next_step: Start project-scoped/read-only and verify separation of user accounts before enabling writes.

name: Miro
rationale: Turn planning boards into task context and update diagrams.
blocker: Documentation conflicts on plan eligibility; session replacement behavior needs checking.
next_step: Confirm eligible plans and multi-client sessions, then test reading and updating a board.

name: Figma
rationale: Design context is valuable for agents implementing product tasks.
blocker: Our client needs admission to Figma MCP Catalog.
next_step: Apply for client access, then validate scope, design reads and canvas writes.

name: Vercel
rationale: Link deployment and runtime context to execution tasks.
blocker: Reviewed-client requirement; our app is not automatically covered by a harness vendor approval.
next_step: Apply with our redirect URIs; validate team/project access and tool set.

name: Canva
auth: Approved client; registered OAuth or CIMD; DCR compatibility
rationale: Create visual deliverables directly from tasks.
blocker: Developer Portal self-serve registration not yet available in reviewed docs; waitlist required.
next_step: Join client-access waitlist; implement supported registered OAuth/CIMD path when available.

name: monday.com
rationale: Broaden task/project support for team users.
blocker: Public integration must be reviewed; private token testing does not authorize public rollout.
next_step: Apply for public client registration and map board/item semantics to task adapters.
